description: Na₃Be₃Pb₂F₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent PbF₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Be-F bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.59 Å. In the second Be site, Be is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four F atoms. There are three shorter (1.56 Å) and one longer (1.58 Å) Be-F bond length. In the third Be site, Be is bonded to four F atoms to form BeF₄ tetrahedra that share  an edgeedge with one PbF₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Be-F bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted PbF₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent BeF₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one BeF₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-F bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.54 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Pb-F bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.72 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Be and two Pb atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Be, and two Pb atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Be atom. In the tenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one Be atom. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na and one Be atom. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Be, and one Pb atom. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Pb atoms.
